venue.name: The Butchart Gardens - National Historic Site
venue.description: The Butchart Gardens is a 122-year-old, 55-acre privately owned display garden at 800 Benvenuto Ave in Brentwood Bay, BC, created by Jennie Butchart and still operated by the family; it was designated a National Historic Site of Canada in 2004. It is open year round with seasonal hours and rates and includes the Sunken, Rose, Japanese, Italian and Mediterranean Gardens, a Rose Carousel, four food service outlets and a Seed & Gift Store, and it accepts organized school field trips only between October 15 and April 15.
venue.hours_notes: The published hours are admission gate times; "The Gardens are open for viewing one hour after the gates close." Summer 2026 (June 1 - September 15): Monday-Tuesday 9:00am-5:00pm, Wednesday-Sunday 9:00am-10:00pm. September 16-30: daily 9:00am-5:00pm. October: daily 9:00am-4:00pm. November: daily 9:00am-3:30pm. Christmas December 1-24 and December 26 - January 6: daily 3:00pm-9:00pm. January 7-17: daily 9:00am-3:30pm. February 1-28: daily 9:00am-3:30pm. March: daily 9:00am-4:00pm. April and May: daily 9:00am-5:00pm. Open statutory holidays. Hours are subject to change without notice.
venue.seasonal_notes: Open year round except December 25 (closed) and January 18-31, 2027 (closed for staff holiday). Admission rates change by season. School field trips are accepted October 15 - April 15 only. If it rains, staff distribute complimentary umbrellas throughout the grounds and parking lots.
venue.price_year_or_season: Summer 2026 (June 1 - September 15) rates; the Hours & Rates page was last modified 2026-06-24 and lists rates through Spring 2027

programs.name: School Group / Field Trip (self-guided)
programs.description: Organized school groups and field trips are welcomed October 15 - April 15 only; no school field trips are accepted after April 16. Advance reservations are required and are based on availability, through Group Services. Visits are restricted to a maximum of 2 hours and a maximum group size of 60 students, with a chaperone requirement of 1 adult per 10 students; based on that 1:10 ratio the Gardens provide complimentary chaperone admission. Students pay the child and youth seasonal rates from the Hours & Rates page: within the school field trip window the child (5-12) rate is $3.00 in October, November, January 7-14, February, March and April, and $5.00 during the Christmas period (December 1 - January 6); youth (13-17) rates in the same window range from $12.60 to $21.13. All chaperones must read and sign the School Group & Field Trip Policy form before arrival and must stay with their group at all times, including in the gift shop, restaurants and carousel areas. Groups must break into units of 10 or fewer before entering the turnstiles. The Gardens state they are a private display garden and not a playground or park: no backpacks (except for medical reasons), no outside meals in The Gardens (small snacks only in designated areas, coordinated in advance), no running or throwing games, no music or performances, and scavenger hunts are not permitted. The Gardens do not offer or permit guided tours - all visits are self-guided.
programs.evidence: Based on the 1:10 ratio, we will provide complimentary chaperone admission.

programs.name: Child & Youth Group visit (self-guided)
programs.description: Separate from school field trips, The Gardens accept child and youth groups (for example daycare, camp and youth organization groups). Advance reservations are required and are based on availability, through Group Services at 250-652-4422 or groups@butchartgardens.com. The chaperone requirement is 1 adult per 10 students and, based on that 1:10 ratio, chaperone admission is complimentary. Child and youth seasonal rates apply: child (5-12) is $5.00 in Summer 2026 (June 1 - September 15), $3.00 October 1 - November 30, $5.00 during Christmas (December 1 - January 6), $3.00 January 7 - April 30 and $5.00 in May; youth (13-17) is $22.13 in Summer 2026 and ranges from $12.60 to $22.80 across the other seasons. The value recorded here is the Summer 2026 child rate. No maximum group size and no time limit are published for child and youth groups (unlike school field trips, which are capped at 60 students and 2 hours). All chaperones must read and sign the Youth Group Policies before arrival and must stay with their group at all times. The Gardens do not offer or permit guided tours - all visits are self-guided; a leisurely walk of the main pathways takes 1.5 to 2 hours and covers about 1.5 km.

programs.name: Adult group visit (25+)
programs.description: Adult groups receive a discount upon advance booking if the group is 25 or more adults, arrives together in one vehicle and pays one lump sum. The size of the discount is not published. Optional group food services are available through The Blue Poppy Restaurant, The Dining Room and The Coffee Shop (coffee shop food tickets are sold in $25 and $35 denominations). All groups must abide by the Gardens' Garden Etiquette. Recorded here because a daycare or school may travel with an adult contingent; the minimum of 25 adults is a minimum, not a capacity maximum.
